Ignore punctuation, comment order, line grouping, and synonymous wording."

def review_findings(review, direction):
    import re
    # Canonicalise synonymous predicates, not isolated answer-key keywords.
    # Assertions below relate an action/subject to its consequence, including
    # negative polarity and the zero-quantity form ('restores none').
    text = review.lower().replace("’", "'")
    for a, b in [("doesn't", "does not"), ("can't", "cannot"), ("won't", "will not"), ("isn't", "is not"), ("wouldn't", "would not")]:
        text = text.replace(a, b)
    requirement_text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9.!?;\n]+', ' ', text)
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', text)
    substitutions = [
        (r'\b(?:bring(?:s|ing)? back|recover(?:s|ing|ed|y)?|restor(?:e|es|ing|ed|ation))\b', 'restore'),
        (r'\b(?:recreat(?:e|es|ing|ed)|reintroduc(?:e|es|ing|ed)|re add(?:ing)?|add(?:ing)? back|rebuild(?:ing)?|reconstruct(?:ing)?)\b', 'recreate'),
        (r'\b(?:drop(?:s|ping|ped)?|remov(?:e|es|ing|ed)|delet(?:e|es|ing|ed))\b', 'drop'),
        (r'\b(?:loses?|losing|lost|destroys?|destroyed|discards?|discarded|erases?|wipes?)\b', 'lose'),
        (r'\b(?:fix(?:es|ing)?|repair(?:s|ing)?|amend(?:ing|ment)?|revis(?:e|ion|ing)|correct(?:ion|ing|ed|s)?)\b', 'correction'),
        (r'\b(?:verify|verified|verification|confirm(?:s|ed|ing|ation)?|validate|validation|check(?:ing)?|exercise|exercising|test(?:ing|ed|s)?)\b', 'verify'),
        (r'\b(?:forward migration|upgrad(?:e|ing))\b', 'upgrade'),
        (r'\b(?:inverse|reverse operation|reverse migration|reversal|downgrad(?:e|ing))\b', 'downgrade'),
        (r'\b(?:test|verify|testing|disposable|scratch|non production) (?:database|db)\b', 'testdb'),
        (r'\b(?:sign off|signoff|approve|approved|approval|acceptance)\b', 'approval'),
        (r'\b(?:prior to|ahead of)\b', 'before'),
        (r'\b(?:notes?|values?|contents?|data)\b', 'data'),
    ]
    for pattern, replacement in substitutions:
        text = re.sub(pattern, replacement, text)
        requirement_text = re.sub(pattern, replacement, requirement_text)
    def proposition(pattern):
        return bool(re.search(pattern, text))
    # Punctuation and comment boundaries have no grading significance. Bounded
    # relation spans keep unrelated keyword lists from being treated as findings.
    loss = proposition(r'(?:drop|drop and add|implementation|candidate).{0,100}(?:lose|data loss|data is drop)') or proposition(r'data.{0,50}(?:is|are|gets?|will be) (?:lose|drop)') or proposition(r'\bdrop\b(?:(?!\b(?:not|never|cannot)\b).){0,100}\bdrop (?:the )?data\b')
    no_recovery = (
        proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade|original column|schema).{0,100}(?:does not|will not|cannot|can not|not|never|fails? to).{0,25}restore.{0,60}data')
        or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade|original column|schema).{0,100}restore (?:none|no|zero)(?: of)?(?: the| any)?(?: drop| existing| original)? data')
        or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade|original column|schema).{0,100}(?:data.{0,35}(?:unrecoverable|unrestored|not restore|remain(?:s)? lose)|(?:leaves?|leaving).{0,30}data.{0,25}(?:lose|unrecover|unrestore|missing))')
        or proposition(r'(?:drop|lose) data.{0,50}(?:cannot|can not|will not|not|never).{0,25}(?:be )?restore')
        or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade|original column|schema).{0,100}(?:does not|will not|cannot|can not|not|never|fails? to).{0,25}bring.{0,40}data.{0,10}back')
        or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade|original column|schema).{0,120}rather than restore.{0,60}data')
    )
    # Reject a positive assertion masquerading as a negated loss assertion.
    loss_denial = proposition(r'(?:drop|implementation|candidate).{0,35}(?:does not|will not|never|cannot) lose.{0,30}data')
    # Recovery polarity belongs to the recovery predicate, not any earlier
    # negation in the review. Keep sentence boundaries (except qualified names).
    clauses = re.split(r'[.!?;\n]+', re.sub(r'(?<=\w)\.(?=\w)', ' ', requirement_text))
    recovery_claim = False
    for clause in clauses:
        # The subject must be the proposed inverse/schema recreation, not a
        # different recovery mechanism mentioned elsewhere in the review.
        subject = re.search(r'\b(?:recreate|downgrade|original column|schema)\b', clause)
        if not subject:
            continue
        tail = clause[subject.start():]
        for match in re.finditer(r'\brestore\b|\bbring\b(?=.{0,50}\bdata\b.{0,15}\bback\b)', tail):
            before, after = tail[:match.start()], tail[match.end():]
            data_object = re.match(r'\s+(?:(?:all|every|the|any|those|these|its|their|former|previous|drop|lose|existing|original|stored|of)\s+){0,8}data\b', after)
            negated = re.search(r'\b(?:not|never|cannot|can not|fails? to|rather than|instead of)\s+(?:(?:be|necessarily|automatically|reliably|actually|assumed|to|able)\s+){0,5}$', before)
            if data_object and not negated:
                recovery_claim = True
    # Equivalent explanations may describe an empty/schema-only replacement
    # instead of using the literal 'does not restore deleted data' phrase.
    no_recovery = no_recovery or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade|original column).{0,80}(?:empty column|column.{0,15}empty)')
    no_recovery = no_recovery or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade).{0,80}(?:only|just).{0,20}(?:schema|column).{0,50}(?:not|without).{0,30}data')
    no_recovery = no_recovery or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade).{0,80}restore.{0,25}(?:schema|column).{0,25}(?:but not|not).{0,25}data')
    no_recovery = no_recovery or proposition(r'(?:recreate|downgrade).{0,80}(?:cannot|does not|will not).{0,20}undo.{0,20}data loss')
    loss = loss and not loss_denial
    no_recovery = no_recovery and not recovery_claim
    correction = proposition(r'(?:manual(?:ly)? )?correction.{0,100}(?:required|must|need|before approval|only then.{0,15}approval)') or proposition(r'(?:must|need|required).{0,50}(?:manual(?:ly)? )?correction') or proposition(r'before approval.{0,120}(?:manual(?:ly)? )?correction')
    approval_boundary = proposition(r'before approval|approval.{0,25}(?:only after|requires|depends on)|(?:do not|cannot|withhold|no) approval.{0,60}(?:until|without)|only then.{0,15}approval')
    # Verification must concern both directions on a test database and must
    # precede approval; order of the directions and review comments is irrelevant.
    verification = (
        proposition(r'upgrade') and proposition(r'downgrade')
        and proposition(r'(?:verify.{0,120}testdb|testdb.{0,120}verify)')
        and (proposition(r'(?:verify|testdb).{0,120}(?:required|must|need|before approval)') or proposition(r'(?:must|need|required).{0,120}(?:verify|testdb)') or proposition(r'before approval.{0,120}(?:verify|testdb)'))
        and approval_boundary
    )
    # Preserve polarity within requirement propositions, rather than matching
    # the word 'required' inside 'not required'. Keep clause boundaries here;
    # a positive requirement also ends the span before an unrelated denial.
    def requirement_denied(subject):
        span = r'(?:(?!\b(?:required|needed|necessary|must)\b)[^.!?;\n]){0,120}'
        denial = r'\b(?:not (?:required|needed|necessary|need)|unnecessary)\b'
        return bool(re.search(subject + span + denial, requirement_text))
    correction = correction and not requirement_denied(r'\bcorrection\b')
    verification = verification and not requirement_denied(r'\b(?:verify|testdb)\b')
    # Intent is supplied in the prompt: a review may describe the unsafe
    # implementation without repeating the literal word 'rename'.
    unsafe_rename = loss and proposition(r'drop.{0,60}(?:add|recreate)|(?:add|recreate).{0,60}drop|customer note')
    findings = {'direction': direction, 'correction_before_approval': correction and approval_boundary, 'test_verification_required': verification}
    if direction == 'upgrade':
        findings['possible_rename'] = unsafe_rename
    else:
        findings['deleted_data_not_restored'] = no_recovery
    return findings

def check_review(direction):
    import ast, tokenize, io
    src = Path('exercise.py').read_text().split('# BEGIN LEARNER EDITS\n', 1)[1].split('# END LEARNER EDITS', 1)[0]
    # Ensure both supplied review stubs remain; aggregate the entire review so
    # moving a finding between stubs or regrouping comments does not change it.
    nodes = {n.name: n for n in ast.parse(src).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
    if direction not in nodes:
        return review_findings('', direction)
    comments = [t.string[1:] for t in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(src).readline) if t.type == tokenize.COMMENT and not t.string.lower().lstrip('# ').startswith(('candidate:', 'todo:'))]
    return review_findings(' '.join(comments), direction)

class Cache:
    # Endpoint-ready adapter for cache-aside; not raw Redis serialization.
    def __init__(self):
        self.entries = {}; self.expiry = {}; self.calls = []
    async def get(self, key):
        self.calls.append(("get", key))
        if key in self.expiry and self.expiry[key] <= time.monotonic():
            self.entries.pop(key, None); self.expiry.pop(key, None)
        return self.entries.get(key)
    async def set(self, key, value, ex=None):
        self.calls.append(("set", key, ex)); self.entries[key] = value
        if ex is None: self.expiry.pop(key, None)
        else: self.expiry[key] = time.monotonic()+ex
    async def delete(self, key):
        self.calls.append(("delete", key)); self.entries.pop(key, None); self.expiry.pop(key, None)
    async def ttl(self, key):
        if await self.get(key) is None: return -2
        if key not in self.expiry: return -1
        return max(0, int(self.expiry[key]-time.monotonic()))

        return None
    async def set(self, key, value, ex=None):
        if self.operation == "set": raise self.exception("synthetic cache population failure")
        return await super().set(key,value,ex)
